id./param/scenario/cs/a_100_cs_210.pack|cs_: "Lord Arachtor! I've brought new prey!
"Sshhhhh... Is that today's prey? Hohh... What an exquisite female fighter.
"I'll squeeze her essence out too. Vince, offer her to me.
"Yes, sir!
"Heh, so you showed yourself, mastermind. It was worth getting caught on purpose.
"I heard Hendrik defeated the monster horde that attacked the town sixteen years ago, but a survivor hid here...
"Hm. Well done, Princess.
"Vince, forgive me, but I searched your room.
"What you drank just before the final... that was the essence squeezed out of the fighters, wasn't it?
"I see... So it was you who broke into my room...
"Sshhhhh... That's right, human.
"Sixteen years ago, I was wounded by the hateful Hendrik. I used this man to gather the essence needed to heal that wound.
"Drinking the essence of strong humans heals my wounds. If a human drinks that essence, he gains an invincible body.
"And this man took the bait...
"To keep winning and earn the prize money, I needed the essence of the strong. I'll do anything to protect the orphanage.
"I'm sorry! Now that you know this secret, I can't let you live!
"Damn it... Not now...
"Dear me... You fool. You don't even understand your own body.
"Your body is already ruined by that essence. It's a miracle you can even stand.
"Heh... How pathetic. This is the price of relying on a monster's power...
"Sshhhhh... He's no more use. Weak humans, after all...
"Then Arachtor himself will deal with you personally.
"I'll rescue everyone! I leave the monster to you!
